skills.name: Blazing Sun (阳炎/陽炎)
skills.line: Don't you know not to stare directly into the sun?
skills.description: Hiyoribou focuses the energy of the sun and casts it onto a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Sunshine and Rain (晴雨)
skills.description:
Hiyoribou helps her allies by storing sunshine energy in her Sunshine Doll. Storage limit is equal to her max HP.
When a non-summoned ally receives damage, she stores 25% of the damage as sunshine energy in the Sunshine Doll.
When an enemy ends their turn, she consumes sunshine energy to restore the HP of a non-summoned ally with the lowest HP by 30% of their lost HP.
;

skills.name: Nourishment (滋养/滋養)
skills.description: When an ally is KO'd, and if Hiyoribou's passive is not Sealed, she sacrifices her Sunshine Doll to revive a random KO'd ally and restores their HP by 100% of their max HP. Also spends 50% of the stored sunshine energy to restore the HP all non-summoned allies by a shared amount. The Sunshine Doll revives in 4 turns. If multiple Hiyoribou are present, all of their Sunshine Dolls will be sacrificed. When using this skill while Hiyoribou's Sunshine Doll is present, stores sunshine energy equal to 25% of her max HP. When the Sunshine Doll is sacrificed, decreased its revival cooldown by 1.

upgrades.text: When using this skill, stored sunshine energy increases to 40%.
Sunshine Doll's revival cooldown decreases to 3.
